from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from temporalio.client import Client
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/procurement/workflows")

class AbortPayload(BaseModel):
    cancellation_code: str
    reason: str

@router.post("/{workflow_id}/signal/abort-shipment")
async def signal_abort_shipment(
    workflow_id: str,
    payload: AbortPayload,
    temporal_client: Client = Depends(get_temporal_client),
    buyer: BuyerAccount = Depends(get_buyer_account),
    order_svc: ProcurementOrderService = Depends(get_order_service)
):
    order = await order_svc.get_order_by_workflow_id(workflow_id)
    if not order:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Procurement order not found")
    if order.buyer_company_id != buyer.company_id and not buyer.is_procurement_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: buyer does not have authority to abort this order workflow")

    handle = temporal_client.get_workflow_handle(workflow_id)
    await handle.signal("abort_order_shipment", payload.cancellation_code, payload.reason)
    return {"status": "signal_dispatched", "workflow_id": workflow_id}
